relations.subject: Quintin Craufurd
relations.evidence: British (Scottish) Civil Servant in India . Younger son of the elder Quintin Craufurd and Ann Robinson. As a typical Nabob he earned a fortune in India in E.I.C.’s service. Returned from India in 1780
